By this application the Petitioner seeks to withdraw the present petition as the matter has now been settled between the Petitioner and Mr.Gautam Tiwari, the accused.
Copy of the settlement agreement executed on 01.11.2023 before the Mediation Centre, Saket Courts, New Delhi has been placed on record.

It is further stated that all other cases inter-se between the parties, details of which have been enumerated in para 2 of the application, have also been disposed of in view of the settlement between the parties.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned ASC for the State accepts notice and submits that he has no objection to the present application being allowed in view of the settlement between the parties.
Accordingly, the application is allowed permitting the Petitioner to withdraw the present petition.
